behavior: Full-year recovery derives its exact original XML and source_* keys from the validated retained approval, durable claim and complete journal, instead of reading current source facts.

Validates confirmation/dialog UUIDs against the succeeded journal and rejects duplicate confirmation keys before acquiring a read-only provider token.
Invalid or missing archive evidence releases the claimed lease without a provider call; unconfirmed unknown outcomes cannot invent a reference or replay a POST.
Legacy send explicitly rejects full-year approvals; no full-year send endpoint or production activation is added.
Ledger disposable-container readiness now checks TCP so the temporary socket-only initialization server cannot be mistaken for the final server.
